scripts.build: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build:notification-helper && electron-vite build
scripts.preview: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build:notification-helper && electron-vite preview
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --linux --publish never
scripts.package:linux:dir: pnpm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --linux --dir --publish never
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build && node scripts/package-windows.mjs --win --publish never --config.npmRebuild=false
scripts.package:win:dir: pnpm run build && node scripts/package-windows.mjs --win --dir --publish never --config.npmRebuild=false
scripts.verify:packaged-runtime-deps:linux: pnpm run verify:runtime-model-registry && cross-env PI_APP_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=linux node scripts/assert-packaged-runtime-deps.mjs
scripts.verify:packaged-runtime-deps:windows: pnpm run verify:runtime-model-registry && cross-env PI_APP_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win32 node scripts/assert-packaged-runtime-deps.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:all: pnpm run test:e2e:core && pnpm run test:e2e:live && pnpm run test:e2e:native
scripts.test:e2e:runner: pnpm build && sh -c 'if [ "$1" = "--" ]; then shift; fi; pnpm --dir ../.. exec playwright test -c apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts "$@"' --
scripts.test:e2e:core: pnpm build && cross-env PI_APP_TEST_LANE=core PI_APP_REAL_AUTH=0 PI_APP_TEST_MODE=background pnpm --dir ../.. exec playwright test -c apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts apps/desktop/tests/core
scripts.test:e2e:native: pnpm build && cross-env PI_APP_TEST_MODE=foreground pnpm --dir ../.. exec playwright test -c apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts apps/desktop/tests/native
